**Resubmitted: deviation (T4C), preferred-level cure.**

Repairs made in response to the verifier:
- **Alias check:** the new right now runs to "Teleglobe USA Inc. (the "Customer")" and the refund obligation runs to "the Customer", so the Customer convenience right is expressed in playbook-alias operative language (client identity confirmed from the signature block at p0322).
- **Numbering:** the inserted text carries its own "18.8" subparagraph number so it is citable and cannot read as a continuation of 18.7.
- **Refund scope:** "any amounts prepaid" narrowed to "any charges prepaid by the Customer in respect of the period after the effective date of such termination", so it cannot be read as sweeping in capital contributions and circumventing the 18.4 no-credit rule.

Unchanged and confirmed: one insertion only; 18.1's end-of-Initial-Period exit, the 18.2 unanimity route, the 18.4 forfeiture and the 18.7 liability apportionment all survive untouched and remain tied to Subparagraph 18.1; the counterparty-side element is mapped as already_met on the verbatim 18.1 quote rather than re-drafted. The absence of a mid-Initial-Period interest-reallocation mechanic is flagged as a negotiation exposure, not an element defect.
